profile.name: 实验数据文件写入器
profile.description: 用于实验扫描过程中记录和导出数据的通用文件写入组件。它负责保存文件头、测量数据以及相关元数据，如用户名、命令、注释、开始/结束时间、设备列表、信号列表和对应数据。
profile.description_en: A generic file-writing component used to record and export data during laboratory scan workflows. It stores headers, measurement data, and related metadata such as username, command, comments, start/end timestamps, device lists, signal lists, and associated data.

A generic file-writing component used to record and export data during laboratory scan workflows. It stores headers, measurement data, and related metadata such as username, command, comments, start/end timestamps, device lists, signal lists, and associated data.
